description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
